Cartesian coordinates across multiple genomic loci

Source: R/coord-locus.R
coord_loci.Rd

Places several genomic windows side by side on one linear x-axis, so tracks can show distant loci, on the same or different chromosomes, in a single panel. Every layer whose data has seqnames and start columns has its positions converted to the linear axis before aesthetics are evaluated: rows outside all windows are dropped, and with more than one window, ranges are clipped to the window edges and split across windows they span. Data with two anchors, with seqnames1, start1, seqnames2, and start2 columns as from devgru::read_bedpe_file(output_type = "dt"), has both anchors converted and keeps rows with at least one anchor in view; the anchor out of view is set to NA. Layers without these columns are left untouched.

Also adds an x-axis scale with breaks and labels in each window's own coordinates, and window labels on the top axis.

Usage

coord_loci(
  windows,
  flank = 0,
  widths = c("proportional", "equal"),
  gap = 0.02,
  dividers = TRUE,
  window_labels = NULL,
  expand = TRUE,
  clip = "on"
)

Arguments

windows

Genomic windows as one of:

  • A character vector of windows, e.g. "chr8:127600001-128000000". Names, if given, are used as window labels.

  • A data frame with seqnames, start, and end columns and an optional label column.

  • A GRanges object, with an optional label metadata column.

flank

Number of bp to extend both ends of each window, default: 0

widths

How the axis is shared between windows: "proportional" (default) to each window's length in bp, or "equal" so small windows stay readable next to large ones, each then at its own scale.

gap

Space between windows as a fraction of the total axis, default: 0.02

dividers

Draw dashed lines between windows, default: TRUE

window_labels

Labels of the windows on the top axis, as one of:

  • NULL (default): labeled with more than one window, by the names of windows or else the chromosome.

  • A character vector with one label per window.

  • TRUE or FALSE to show or hide the default labels. In a stack, keep the labels on the top track only.

expand

If TRUE, the default, adds a small expansion to the window limits.

clip

Should drawing be clipped to the extent of the plot panel? Default: "on"

Value

List of a coord and an x-axis scale, added to a plot with +

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
windows <- c(MYC = "chr8:127700001-128000000", IGH = "chr14:105550001-106880000")

ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_gene_track(genes_of_interest = c("MYC", "PVT1")) +
  coord_loci(windows) +
  theme_genomic(y_axis = "blank")
} # }
